PlayAI appears in the dataset with one product, Play.ht, classified as voice synthesis.

The record contains no figures on compute usage, model size, inference volume, or energy draw. It therefore offers no evidence about how PlayAI's voice synthesis contributes to the grid constraint that the site tracks.

What the data does establish is narrow: a company exists and offers a voice synthesis product. Any conclusion about buildings, power, or compute scaling would have to come from sources outside this record.
